text:
ana_docs: Quick flag - noticed the docs site uses mixed terms: "model family", "model version", and sometimes just "model id" in examples. We should standardize and add one-line rules in the style guide.
sara_docs: agree. Proposed canonical forms: use `model` in API examples (callable id), `model version` when referring to a specific build, and `model family` for grouping.
leo_eng: backend accepts `model` and `model_id` for now. If docs push `model` we should add a Compat note so users know legacy keys still work.
maya_ux: UX note: in the Console use Title Case labels (Model family, Model version). In prose use sentence case (model family). Add that to tone doc.
lint-bot: repo grep: 34 matches across docs/, 5 in examples/, 3 in sdk-snippets/ -> https://ci/reports/term-variants-2134005555
sara_docs: plan: 1) add short table in docs/style/terminology.md 2) update glossary.md with defs 3) sweep examples for `model_id` -> `model`. I'll take docs/ and examples/.
leo_eng: I'll update sdk-snippets and leave a compatibility note in docs/migration/params.md. Will run snippet tests after.
ana_docs: thanks all. Aim to get PRs up today; ping here when ready and I'll coordinate review. :mag:
